invariants.rationale: Parallelism should be positive for meaningful parallel processing.
The input List<I> 'data' should not be null for map to operate correctly.
The SerializableFunction<I, O> 'func' must be non-null to apply mapping.
Parallelism should not exceed the number of available processors for efficiency.
If the input is not empty, parallelism should not exceed the input size to avoid wasted computation.
